blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Freight is the general word for goods being transported. The carrier is the company that moves them. A shipment is a specific batch being sent. The load is what fills a truck or a container. Freight cost is what you pay to move it all.

These words appear in every logistics conversation and every invoice. Getting them right makes you sound professional very quickly. Getting them wrong, even once, makes people wonder whether you know what you are doing.

Learn five words. Use them correctly. The rest follows.

items.q: What is "freight"?
options: The company that moves the goods
The general word for goods being transported
items.why: "Freight is the general word for goods being transported."

items.q: Who is the carrier?
options: The company that moves the goods
The customer who buys the goods
items.why: "The carrier is the company that moves them."

items.q: What is a shipment?
items.why: "A shipment is a specific batch being sent."

items.q: The text suggests that using these words wrongly…
items.why: Inferência: "makes people wonder whether you know what you are doing" — as pessoas duvidam de você.

items.q: What does "The rest follows" most likely mean?
options: There is nothing more to learn
The other words come later, but these five are the base
You must learn a hundred words first
items.why: Inferência: aprender essas cinco palavras é a base; o resto vem depois.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry orientando a nova assistente de logística. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, your first customer call is tomorrow. Don't worry. You only need five words, and you already know them.

First, freight. That is the goods we move. Sugar, samples, commodities — all freight. Second, the carrier. That is the company with the trucks and the ships. We are not the carrier. We book the carrier.

Third, a shipment. That is one batch, one order going out. Fourth, the load. The load is what fills one truck or one container. And fifth, the freight cost. That is the price. The customer always asks about the freight cost.

So on the call, keep it simple. Say "your shipment is ready" or "the carrier will collect it on Monday." Short and clear. If you use these five words correctly, you will sound professional from the first minute.

Take your time. Speak slowly. And remember, freight is one big word — we don't say "one freight" or "two freights." We say "one shipment," "two shipments." You've got this.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many words does Harry say she needs?
items.why: "You only need five words."

items.q: Is Czarnikow the carrier?
items.why: "We are not the carrier. We book the carrier."

items.q: What does the customer always ask about?
items.why: "The customer always asks about the freight cost."

items.q: Why does Harry give her simple sentences to say?
options: Because the customer speaks no English
So she sounds clear and professional
Because the call is very long
items.why: Inferência: frases curtas e claras a fazem soar profissional desde o começo.

items.q: Why does Harry mention "one shipment, two shipments"?
options: To show that freight is uncountable but shipment is countable
items.why: Inferência: ele ensina que 'freight' não tem plural, mas 'shipment' sim (contável vs incontável).

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The carrier will collect the boxes on Friday." A carrier is…
options: the company that transports the goods
items.why: Carrier = transportadora, a empresa que move a carga.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Your ___ of sugar is ready. It leaves tonight."
items.why: Shipment = remessa: um lote específico que está sendo enviado.

items.q: "We put the whole load into one truck." The load is…
options: what fills the truck or container
items.why: Load = carga: aquilo que enche o caminhão ou o contêiner.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The customer wants to know the ___ before booking."
items.why: Freight cost = custo do frete, o preço para mover a carga.

items.q: "We sent one container by ship." A container is…
options: a large metal box for transporting goods
items.why: Container = contêiner: a grande caixa de metal usada no transporte.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em conversas de logística. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The carrier will pick up the load on Monday." To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = pegar, coletar a carga.

items.q: "We need to send out the shipment today." To send out means to…
items.why: Send out = despachar, fazer sair.

items.q: "Can you set up the call with the carrier?" To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = organizar, marcar.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the freight cost." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Please fill in the invoice before you send it." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher com as informações.
